item.title: Falcom announces Dragon Slayer Project for console
item.description: Falcom has announced Dragon Slayer Project, its tentatively titled 45th anniversary project for console. A genre, specific platforms, and a release date were not announced.

item.title: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta Launches April 28th For Nintendo Switch
item.description: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta launches April 28th, 2026 for Nintendo Switch.

item.title: The UK Has Gone Mad for Resident Evil After the Huge Success of Requiem on PS5
item.description: Capcom recently released Resident Evil Requiem, and it's been so successful that it's seemingly dragging along every other Resi game with it. That's certainly true in the UK; the latest physical retail charts have come in, and the top 10 includes five Resident Evil games across all platforms.

item.title: The craft of voice acting with Jennifer Hale
item.description: Famed actress Jennifer Hale discusses the modern landscape of voice acting and how developers can collaborate with performers to make better games.

item.title: Don Daglow and Rebecca Ann Heineman to be honored at 2026 GDCAs
item.description: Don Daglow will receive the Lifetime Achievement Award, and Rebecca Ann Heineman will posthumously receive the Ambassador Award.

item.title: Developer use of generative AI may be declining
item.description: New data from the Game Developer collective shows a sharp year-over-year drop in reported use of generative AI.

item.title: Officially Licensed Piaggio P.180 Avanti II Coming for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
item.description: Today, FlightFX announced via press release that its Piaggio P.180 Avanti II is coming soon to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, with an update coming to MSFS 2020.

item.title: Nintendo Completes Share Repurchase and Sets Price for Secondary Offering
item.description: Nintendo completed its share repurchase and set its secondary offering price at 8,347 yen ahead of March 16 delivery.

item.title: Steam Tower Defense Fest 2026 Runs March 9 to 16
item.description: Steam Tower Defense Fest 2026 runs March 9 to 16 with discounts on tower defense titles including Bloons TD 6, Kingdom Rush 5, and more.

item.title: Marvel Rivals implements a "Victim Compensation Protocol" as people are getting paid to throw
item.description: Marvel Rivals maker NetEase has detailed a big upgrade for its anti-throwing system, implemented after waves of people started getting paid to deliberately throw and sabotage matches.
